snapshot_method: generation_review.initialize: SQLite backup from readonly connection; independent media files; no export expansion

measurement_protocol.quartiles: Hyndman-Fan type 7: sorted x, index=(n-1)*q, linear interpolation
measurement_protocol.cache: Same browser default cache policy on both sides; first is a new document with isolated-origin local/sessionStorage reset, not OS/server cold. Baseline always no-store. Candidate retains content-addressed static and revalidated media browser caching; API remains no-store, and a bounded transactional server cache is the measured optimization. Candidate cache is emptied at round start, no deliberate object prewarm; first miss retained. Repeat is same-document revisit. OS file cache not flushed. Native server restarted per side/round.
measurement_protocol.endpoint: two localhost native servers with identical request timing wrapper; no profiler or SQL tracing during timed comparison
measurement_protocol.media: primary endpoint includes correct text and required controls; image completion/playback recorded separately
measurement_protocol.failures: keep raw timeout/failure rows; no sample exclusion based on slowness; no tail claim at n=10
measurement_protocol.snapshot: independent APFS copies of frozen-instance; tests write only separate correctness instance
measurement_protocol.slow_paths: API-backed page/scene/card waits reproduced in exploratory baseline; same-scene shot navigation already has no API and is checked for regression separately
measurement_protocol.observer: Identical inline DOM observer injected by the local timing wrapper into both HTML responses. Browser actions remain real Chrome clicks. All primary timestamps are from performance.now/timeOrigin; CDP/tool round-trip time is excluded.
measurement_protocol.search_input: Chrome pressSequentially: actual trusted input events; initial input through last character and 150 ms debounce are included
measurement_protocol.server_restart: Each side process restarted before each round; independent read-only snapshot copies reused after hash verification; no OS page cache flush
measurement_protocol.browser_cache_initialization: New never-used loopback port for each final candidate round; baseline is no-store. No global browser cache clearing or user-tab state modification. Isolated origin session/localStorage reset on every new document.

observation_recovery.reason: Chrome AX returned unreachable while screenshot and DOM snapshot showed the page correctly; one interrupted observation was logged, the current page timing was recovered without altering its endpoint
observation_recovery.fallback: documented Playwright DOM snapshot after readiness

previous_protocol_cache: All baseline/candidate HTTP responses use no-store (verified per sampled ResourceTiming transfer). First = new document and isolated-origin local/session storage reset by the identical observer; repeat = same-document revisit. Request-local server data starts empty on every request. OS file cache is not purged.

user_experience_target.reply: 主要内容通常在 300 毫秒内可用
user_experience_target.metric: P75 <= 300 ms for each common path and first-new-document/repeat condition; cold cache rebuilds separately reported

prototype_runs: V1 candidate round1 incomplete, not final evidence
final_candidate_journal: DELETE for business and disposable cache; no WAL on unverified deployed runtime
